content: bpg/terraform-provider-proxmox v0.111.1 (Jul 2026) is the actively developed Proxmox IaC provider (Terraform 1.5+/OpenTofu 1.6+; Proxmox VE 9.x compatible). Supports VMs and LXC containers plus cloud-init guides. telmate/proxmox is stale. OpenTofu v1.12.3 current. Pattern: clone from cloud-init template, initialization block with user-data snippets.
